items.title: Louis Armstrong Interview, 1960-08-09
items.q: A dear friend of mine, Robert Guffin, he's a big lawyer there.

ctx.x: Do you think European people over there have just feeling they're good, though? Anyway, you're worried about it.

The audience is going to enjoy you and things. The people there come there to hear what we're going to do. And from the moment we hit pale moon shining, you know the theme song, everybody sits right there and relax. And from that first note on, the warmth is there. Yeah. Right there in your country, Belgium. A dear friend of mine, Robert Guffin, he's a big lawyer there. And he wrote a book on frontier of jazz years ago. Where we were born probably, you know. That's how far back Belgium is enjoying good jazz and…
I think they have, but do you feel the same way?
